title: Looking forward to coming and tasting your menu!
text: On this very hectic evening with the youth riot at Plaça Catalunya, the team handled our arrival very well. Good musical atmosphere, good choices were offered to us on the menu, and the quality was there. We would like to thank LUCA for his advice and service.
author: Njenguerrand

title: Hard Rock Cafe
text:
We had a fabulous night here at the Hard Rock Cafe. The atmosphere was so good! With great choice of music and different artists attire hanging on the walls (we had our tea next to Michael Jacksons bowling shirt, how unreal!!!) 

Our server was just wonderful Simone she was so pleasant and sweet and really made us feel welcome.

We had such great food I had chicken & fries and my boyfriend had a smash burger and there were no complaints from either of us. 

We ordered some cocktails and even paid an extra €5 to take home a souvenir glass which is going in our new home. Our server gave me 15% o
author: E9914NLlaureng

title: You can't miss seeing this Hard Rock
text:
Wonderful lunches!
High quality!
Excellent environment and service!
Besides the Legendary, try the Fajitas!
Great cost/benefit!
author: 82carlosrobertod

title: Great food & vibe good with allergies
text: We had a fantastic dining experience! Lovely vibe inside! The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish full of flavor and beautifully prepared. What really stood out was how accommodating the staff were with food allergies. They took our dietary requirements seriously, were knowledgeable about the menu, and made sure everything was safe without compromising on taste. The service was friendly and attentive throughout. We left feeling well looked after and Highly recommend!
author: NorLye

title: Nice Little Hard Rock
text: Small HRC but some neat memorabilia there. Food was cooked well and staff were friendly. Our waitress spoke excellent English. Food was a bit slow (and it wasn’t busy) but we were in no rush.
author: tshep42

title: Bin there, done that, bought the t-shirt.
text:
A city trip with a Hard Rock Café always means dinner in this café.
There is a nice vibe with loud music and the quality of the food from the chain is the same everywhere.
Aperitifs Mojito and Long Island Ice Tea were delicious.
We started with the Spicy Shrimps as an appetizer.
For main course this time we didn't have hamburgers but we did have the Famous Fajitas, my wife with chicken, me with beef and chicken mixed.
Great food in a very moody restaurant.
author: luciussilvae

title: Fantastic Food, Drinks & Live Singer
text:
We always try to eat at a Hard Rock whenever we visit a new city or area that has one and Barcelona’s did not disappoint.
Didn’t have to wait too long for a table and they also have online booking to avoid any wait. John our waiter was so enthusiastic, friendly and helpful. Our food was amazing and so tasty. drinks were great too and the free soft drink refills were great for the kids.
Around 9pm there was a live singer performing who really got the place going. he’d a good voice and covered a wide range of songs to suit everyone. Atmosphere was brilliant. We all had a fantastic time
author: angierey

title: Great experience, lovely staff, lovely food.
text: Great evening meal last week.  Visited with husband and two children, we all had a lovely meal, all ordering different things from the menu (fajitas, burgers, noddle bowl).  Lovely welcome and served by a very kind, helpful and patient Argentinian waiter who was very patient and encouraging with our two children whilst they practised ordering and asking for the bill in Spanish.  Great central location and lovely atmosphere.  Would highly recommend.
author: allisonw393

title: Store Staff Service
text: Staff was incredible 10/10; Andrea and Paula were the best staff members in the shop. So helpful, kind, patient, etc. Ask for them when you come
